description: Extend the existing Channels-owned conversation identity contract, not Mattermost-specific code. Normalize provider/config/channel/user plus stable external thread/root identity at CommunicationBridge and :conversation_identity. Action reuse: extend existing CommunicationBridge APIs and Channels.Api event; no new Action/tool because this is boundary normalization. Contract: JSON-safe stable identity; channel_id and thread_id separate; blank thread means channel-level; email bridge callback precedence; BO compatibility; invalid values fail closed. Tests first: generic Jido chat channels, channel/thread/config/user differences, absent thread, email preservation.

comments.text: Implemented generic stamped identity dimensions (channel_config_id, channel_id, thread_id, participant_id) while preserving bridge-owned key semantics.
